BmTAuZiSJBSN3g5s.source:
As elsewhere in Ulthuan, Cothique is ruled by its nobility. Highborn sons and daughters have the title of prince or princess, a rank that makes them peers to all other nobles save the phoenix king. Seniority itself has little meaning in political life, though older princes have more experience in games of social manipulation and peddling influence, so are treated with careful circumspection by those wise enough to grant it.

The primacy of intrigue means a skilled schemer prevails when those with workable plans for improvement or demonstrable leadership skills fall from grace. Despite this, intrigue is usually carried out in a spirit of courtesy and sportsmanship. Asur nobles generally act in what they believe to be their people’s best interests and trust others to do the same. This makes bitter enmity between the highborn families historically rare. After all, a rival in the present may become someone with whom a prince shares significant interests a few brief decades later.

The political landscape has been recently complicated by the emergence of Asur merchant houses, confederations of lesser nobles and daring entrepreneurs who have gained power by cornering opportunities in foreign lands. The houses of Tallaindeloth and Lianllach are the most notorious among these in Cothique and actively engage in high-level intrigue.

The Council of Seven Princes

Kingdom-level policy is determined by a council of seven princes and princesses, each representing a noble family that rules a city. Though the prince who takes a seat may potentially be changed through council vote, the existing status quo has been maintained since the reign of Caradryel the Peacemaker. This council hears concerns from local representatives, ranging from lesser nobles to more humble citizens and even, on occasion, the nature spirits of Cothique.

Anirain, Cothique’s former capital, remains entitled to two seats despite having been razed during the Sundering. The ease with which it forms political coalitions has long affected the shape of the kingdom. Prince Interik maintains his landless position through talented politicking, careful application of his modest army, and the mercantile talent of Arianne, his daughter, heir apparent, and second councillor.

The Seventh Seat

If the assembly does not reach a clear consensus on a matter, it is the privilege of the occupant of the council’s seventh seat to make a final decision. The seventh seat is the greatest political prize in Cothique.

As the kingdom’s capital, @UUID[JournalEntry.rgmnc6cyvSCdaoKT]{Tor Koruali} has a claim to the seat, but @UUID[JournalEntry.rgmnc6cyvSCdaoKT.JournalEntryPage.WMhkCXVLGqxR9uF9]{Crown Prince Dalloran} has no ambition to take it, maintaining that the prince of Anirain should occupy the seat to honour its sacrifice. The decision is made easy by Interik’s reliable support in council matters, and cynics may note that his palace in Tor Koruali is the greatest of his few remaining possessions. Many believe that, when and if either of Dalloran’s sons, @UUID[JournalEntry.rgmnc6cyvSCdaoKT.JournalEntryPage.4ALEy4GgFL04MQKj]{Dannor and Dalroth}, should replace him, they would fail to exhibit the grace embodied in their father.

Certain scions of Cothique’s merchant houses feel that the dominance of the highborn deprives the council of a rounded point of view. They lobby for Lord Tallaindeloth, governor of Mistnar, to gain a seat. This position wins the cautious sympathy of many of Cothique’s citizens. They point out, with due regret, that Mistnar contributes more than the ruins of Anirain, and they also suggest that it prevents Tor Koruali from taking the seventh seat. Their unspoken fear is that if Dannor or Dalroth were to take it, it would lead to their misrule.

Schemes of House Lianllach

Traditionalists within the assembly fear the consequences should a merchant house seize the seventh seat. Lord Tallaindeloth is a respectable Elf, but his closest ally, the house of Lianllach, is headless, having ousted its lord and adopted rule by a democratic council. This sets an intimidating precedent, not least because recent rumours suggest Lianllach dealings with Dark Elf corsairs.

Should any Characters receive the patronage of an important Elf in Tor Koruali, they may be tasked with confirming these rumours. Perhaps they are spread merely to tarnish the reputation of a powerful merchant house, or perhaps Lianllach traitors really do meet with Dark Elves beyond the Shifting Isles, providing the corsairs with information on the planned future voyages of their competitors. Either way, House Lianllach will not appreciate the scrutiny should they notice it.
BmTAuZiSJBSN3g5s.text:
Как везде на Ултуане, правит знать. Высокородные сыновья и дочери — принцы и принцессы, равные всей знати кроме короля. Возраст сам по себе мало значит, но опытным в манипуляциях старшим мудро выказывают осторожное уважение.

Из-за первенства интриг искусный хитрец преуспевает, пока умелый руководитель с хорошим планом теряет милость. Но обычно действуют учтиво и спортивно. Знать считает свои цели благом народа и доверяет тому же другим. Поэтому ожесточённая вражда семей исторически редка: нынешний соперник через несколько десятилетий разделит интересы.

Недавно политику усложнили купеческие дома — объединения младшей знати и смелых предпринимателей, усилившихся на чужеземных возможностях. В Котике особенно известны Таллайнделот и Лианллах, участвующие в высших интригах.

Совет семи принцев

Общую политику определяют семь принцев и принцесс от правящих городских семей. Представителя можно сменить голосованием, но порядок сохраняется с Карадриэля Миротворца. Совет слушает местных представителей от младшей знати до простых граждан, иногда духов природы.

Разрушенный при Расколе прежний столичный Анирайн сохраняет два места. Лёгкость образования коалиций давно влияет на страну. Безземельный Интерик держится мастерством политики, осторожным применением небольшой армии и торговым даром дочери-наследницы Арианны, второго советника.

Седьмое место

Если нет ясного согласия, его обладатель принимает окончательное решение. Это высший политический приз Котика.

Столица @UUID[JournalEntry.rgmnc6cyvSCdaoKT]{Тор-Коруали} вправе требовать место, но @UUID[JournalEntry.rgmnc6cyvSCdaoKT.JournalEntryPage.WMhkCXVLGqxR9uF9]{Даллоран} не стремится к нему: пусть принц Анирайна занимает его в честь жертвы города. Решение облегчено верной поддержкой Интерика; циники напоминают, что его дворец в столице — одно из немногих владений. Многие считают, что преемники @UUID[JournalEntry.rgmnc6cyvSCdaoKT.JournalEntryPage.4ALEy4GgFL04MQKj]{Даннор и Далрот} не проявят отцовского великодушия.

Потомки торговых домов считают господство высокородных помехой разностороннему взгляду. Они продвигают правителя Мистнара лорда Таллайнделота. Многие граждане осторожно сочувствуют: Мистнар полезнее руин Анирайна и мешает столице получить решающее место. Негласный страх — дурное правление Даннора или Далрота.

Замыслы Лианллах

Традиционалисты боятся купеческой власти. Таллайнделот почтенен, но союзник Лианллах сверг лорда и правит демократическим советом. Опасный прецедент усиливается слухами о сделках с друкайскими корсарами.

Важный покровитель может поручить героям проверить слухи. Ложь ли это ради порчи репутации или предатели за островами передают маршруты соперников? В любом случае Лианллах не обрадуется обнаруженной слежке.

authorNodes.10: Недавно политику усложнили купеческие дома — объединения младшей знати и смелых предпринимателей, усилившихся на чужеземных возможностях. В Котике особенно известны Таллайнделот и Лианллах, участвующие в высших интригах.
authorNodes.14: Совет семи принцев
authorNodes.18: Общую политику определяют семь принцев и принцесс от правящих городских семей. Представителя можно сменить голосованием, но порядок сохраняется с Карадриэля Миротворца. Совет слушает местных представителей от младшей знати до простых граждан, иногда духов природы.
authorNodes.22: Разрушенный при Расколе прежний столичный Анирайн сохраняет два места. Лёгкость образования коалиций давно влияет на страну. Безземельный Интерик держится мастерством политики, осторожным применением небольшой армии и торговым даром дочери-наследницы Арианны, второго советника.
authorNodes.26: Седьмое место
authorNodes.30: Если нет ясного согласия, его обладатель принимает окончательное решение. Это высший политический приз Котика.
authorNodes.34: Столица {{R:0|Тор-Коруали}} вправе требовать место, но {{R:1|Даллоран}} не стремится к нему: пусть принц Анирайна занимает его в честь жертвы города. Решение облегчено верной поддержкой Интерика; циники напоминают, что его дворец в столице — одно из немногих владений. Многие считают, что преемники {{R:2|Даннор и Далрот}} не проявят отцовского великодушия.
authorNodes.38: Потомки торговых домов считают господство высокородных помехой разностороннему взгляду. Они продвигают правителя Мистнара лорда Таллайнделота. Многие граждане осторожно сочувствуют: Мистнар полезнее руин Анирайна и мешает столице получить решающее место. Негласный страх — дурное правление Даннора или Далрота.
authorNodes.52: Традиционалисты боятся купеческой власти. Таллайнделот почтенен, но союзник Лианллах сверг лорда и правит демократическим советом. Опасный прецедент усиливается слухами о сделках с друкайскими корсарами.
authorNodes.56: Важный покровитель может поручить героям проверить слухи. Ложь ли это ради порчи репутации или предатели за островами передают маршруты соперников? В любом случае Лианллах не обрадуется обнаруженной слежке.

q9WiVBuVMXavuXX6.source:
Cothique’s enchanted skyships leap from the waves to launch mid-air broadsides from their batteries of Eagleclaw Bolt Throwers, while war catamarans deploy from their hawkships to swiftly sail circles around ravenous sea monsters and the cannonry of pirate war galleys from Sartosa. The kingdom’s eagleships are among Ulthuan’s finest, fashioned from salt-kissed livewood, kept supple and capable of regrowth through enchantments woven during the harvesting of starwood and the building of the vessels. They are capable of weathering any storm. These living ships are sometimes still inhabited by stubborn resident Spites, and sailors revere these spirits in accordance with various superstitions, occasionally winning over guardian tricksters to aid them in battle.

The Ships’ Companies

More impressive than their glorious fleet are Cothique’s sailors themselves. These Elves specialise in daring naval tactics and practice manoeuvres that baffle their foes. These sailors leap from their decks during boarding actions or latch onto the hulls of ships travelling at full speed. Scouts borne atop Skycutters, or great flying fish, outflank their foes with derring-do as they skim across the waves.

These sailors of Cothique make up a disproportionate number of those Asur who are otherwise known as the Sea Elves. Due to their maritime lifestyles, when contrasted to most landbound Asur they tend toward rough dispositions and possess a fiery temperament. Although some of these Elves have a roguish and worldly charm, others develop resentment to folk from the Old World due to frequent conflict, making them justifiably mistaken for their dark cousins while away in foreign lands. Indeed, few Men of Bretonnia or the Empire would be able to explain the distinction between a piratically inclined Sea Elf and a Dark Elf raider.

Military Forces

The landbound military is less majestic in comparison. Funding for permanent standing forces pales in comparison to naval investment among Cothique’s nobility, and vainglorious sailors whisper accusations of cowardice about their landlubber peers. Much of the military might in Cothique consists of naval soldiery stationed ashore, eager to return to the waves and reluctant to travel far inland.

Even so, Cothique’s standing army is among the best-respected in the Outer Kingdoms. Its forces are particularly adept at marine assault and eagerly deploy in speedy catamarans to lend aid to Chrace and Yvresse, Cothique’s closest neighbours. Under the strong winds of the coastal regions, this rapid response can dramatically outpace those on foot or even horseback and has led to close ties between the soldiers of Cothique and those of bordering kingdoms.

Policy and Problems

In peacetime, most of Cothique’s forces are deployed in foreign waters, escorting merchant princes, engaging in self-directed suppression of enemy vessels, and adventurously scouting deep into dangerous territory. Rumours abound of less wholesome activities as well; given the lack of supervision inherent to much naval activity, holding the vessels to any account is virtually impossible, and inquiring as to where a sailor acquired their latest haul of treasure is considered terribly impolite.

Cothique faces constant external scrutiny for this lenience. The greatest criticism is that their navy, spread thin on adventure afield, is unprepared to muster for Ulthuan’s defence. While none deny that a fleet is strongest with all vessels at the ready, Cothique’s princes maintain that their far-ranging deployments are a source of strength before anything else, since they win great prizes at sea and their expert sailors can return so quickly that the impact on readiness is minimised.

Cothique’s military has an entirely different and far more serious problem: discipline. Drunken revelry and reckless behaviour have become an issue both among active sailors and at the military academy, accompanying numerous disciplinary incidents ranging from gambling to dockside brawling with Humans from the Old World and other visitors. This is a relatively recent and thoroughly embarrassing development with little apparent source, but it is quickly becoming a growing concern.
q9WiVBuVMXavuXX6.text:
Зачарованные небесные корабли Котика выскакивают из волн для бортовых залпов «Орлиных когтей», а боевые катамараны сходят с кораблей-ястребов, обходя чудовищ и сартозские галеры. Лучшие корабли-орлы созданы из солёной живой древесины; чары при рубке звёздного дерева и постройке сохраняют гибкость и восстановление. Они выдерживают любую бурю. Иногда внутри упорные духи, которых моряки суеверно чтут и порой привлекают к помощи в бою.

Корабельные команды

Моряки впечатляют больше флота: дерзкие тактики, непонятные врагу манёвры, прыжки на абордаже и захват корпуса на полном ходу. Разведчики неборезов и огромных летучих рыб смело обходят фланги над волнами.

Их особенно много среди морских эльфов. По сравнению с сухопутными асурами они грубоваты и вспыльчивы. Одни обаятельны и знают мир, другие после частых конфликтов ненавидят гостей Старого Света, и за границей их понятно путают с друкаями. Немногие бретонцы или имперцы объяснят разницу пирата-уранай и друкайского налётчика.

Военные силы

Сухопутные войска менее величественны. Знать мало вкладывает в них по сравнению с флотом, моряки зовут коллег трусами. Значительная часть войск — морские солдаты на берегу, желающие вернуться на воду и неохотно идущие вглубь.

И всё же постоянная армия уважаема во Внешних королевствах. Она особенно сильна в высадках и на быстрых катамаранах помогает Крейсу и Иврессе. При ветре опережает пеших и конницу, что укрепило связи соседей.

Политика и проблемы

В мирное время большинство сил за рубежом: охраняет торговых принцев, самостоятельно преследует врага и исследует опасные воды. Слухи говорят и о сомнительных делах; при слабом надзоре привлечь корабль к ответу почти невозможно, а вопрос о происхождении сокровищ крайне невежлив.

За мягкость постоянно критикуют: рассеянный флот не готов защищать Ултуан. Принцы признают силу собрания, но считают дальние походы преимуществом, дающим трофеи, а опытные моряки возвращаются достаточно быстро.

Куда серьёзнее дисциплина. Пьянство и безрассудство охватили действующих моряков и академию: азартные игры, драки в доках с людьми и гостями. Недавняя позорная перемена без ясного источника быстро тревожит всё больше.

Great ridges and rock formations stand proud throughout the barren plains of the mainland, and the coasts are craggy and exposed to storms. The rocky terrain, stony soil, and windy weather render much of the kingdom unfit for productive farming without magical assistance. Although some arable lands have been cleared by a dedicated few, much of Cothique’s produce is imported, and its people tend to enjoy diets richer in seafood than is normal on Ulthuan.

Since ancient times, the majority of Cothique’s settlements have been coastal. Its cities are built high on cliffsides and dug down into the rock, built to weather storms and invaders alike. Magically reinforced glass stretches over the top of dug-in areas, allowing natural light and a view of the often-stormy skies above. On sunnier days, the walls of buildings in its whitestone cities are decorated with murals evoking the seas, heavens, and gods. Such artwork is intentionally ephemeral beauty, as Cothique’s harsh conditions soon wash the scenes away.

The kingdom borders the wild and forested realm of Chrace to the north, and the misty and mournful land of Yvresse to the south. Although its rocky plains resemble those of Yvresse, Cothique is windswept and dry, whereas the notorious fogs of its southern neighbour bring moisture and mud. The shrine of Vaul found to the north-west of Cothique is of particular importance to its neighbours, as the priests there possess the skill to shape and repair ithilmar. Even farther north is the Blighted Isle, Altar of Khaine, and the legendary Widowmaker, whose baleful influence, some say, stretches all the way across the sea to reach Cothique itself.

Над пустыми равнинами поднимаются хребты и скалы, берега открыты бурям. Каменная почва и ветры мешают земледелию без магии. Немногие расчистили пашни, но много пищи ввозят, а морепродуктов едят больше обычного.

С древности селились у моря, высоко на утёсах и внутри скал, защищаясь от бурь и врагов. Магически укреплённое стекло покрывает заглублённые участки, давая свет и вид неба. В солнце стены белокаменных городов украшают морем, небесами и богами. Красота намеренно эфемерна: непогода скоро смывает росписи.

Северная граница — дикий лесной Крейс, южная — туманный скорбный Иврессе. Равнины схожи, но Котик сух и ветрен, сосед влажен и грязен. Святилище Ваула на северо-западе важно соседям: там формуют и чинят итильмар. Ещё севернее Гиблый остров, алтарь и Вдоводел, чья тьма, говорят, достигает Котика через море.

Cothique is known for its rugged landscape and difficult seas. It is a land of harsh weather and bears old but ugly scars of having been besieged multiple times during bitter conflicts with the Dark Elves of Naggaroth. It may be a surprise to those who travel to Ulthuan to learn that many sites in the kingdom of Cothique are built, partially or wholly, underground. Exposure to enemies and the elements alike has forced Cothique’s Elves to dig into the shale and soil of their homeland, and grand redoubts and defensible tunnels have been carved beneath the cliffside settlements that overlook its shores.

The commonplace enchantments learned by the Elves of Cothique reflect the needs and desires of its people, ranging from humble, industrious prayers of fishermen to the predatory urges of piratical sailors. The maritime traditions, outward-facing attitudes, and stoic endurance of Cothique’s harsh lands and weather shape local practices into something unique among the kingdoms of Ulthuan.

Mathlann

Mathlann, the god of the oceans, is Cothique’s preeminent deity. Many High Elves fear his fickle moods and ward against his destructive wrath, but not so in Cothique. Here, Elves feel a strong connection to the seas, and revere Mathlann not only for the bounty of his waters, but for the challenges too. It is his trials that have made them among the finest sailors in the world.

Small shrines to Mathlann are littered everywhere throughout Cothique. Most homes have at least one altar to the god, and even the smallest boats have his rune painted somewhere, both to display reverence and avoid offence. Simple prayers to Mathlann shape many of the petty magics in Cothique. Invocations for waterproofing objects and orientation during fog are frequently taught to Asur youths, and the kingdom’s many storm weavers work more powerful enchantments to use in the manufacture of practical equipment such as self-righting astrolabes, perfect compasses, fast-drying garments, glowing fishing lures, and the like.

Storm weavers are respected for their counsel on matters of war, trade, and public conduct. Their knowledge of coming storms sets the pace of life across Cothique. Ships blessed with a storm weaver are rightly considered among the most dangerous on the oceans. The blessed of Mathlann are easily capable of scuttling fleets single-handedly by summoning dread monsters from the depths and weaving their eponymous storms, but they also enable feats of tactical dominance by rendering Cothique’s ships invisible in fog and directing the winds.

Isha and the Green Wind

As Cothique’s wind-scarred landscape is notoriously difficult to farm, its residents rely on inter-kingdom trade, hunting, and fishing to supplement local produce. Expertise with Ghyran, the Green Wind, is almost mandatory to farm in Cothique, either to revitalise its salt-fallow soil or to create and maintain a glasshouse,

a self-contained environment safer for a plant than leaving it exposed to the ocean wind. Some plants are notoriously difficult to rear in glasshouses, and doing so successfully is considered a sign of favour by Isha.

The Green Wind also sees use in the tending of the Starwood Groves, a natural resource that is among Cothique’s most important for naval construction. Shrines to Isha dot the forest, and complex rituals of High Magic and Ghyran are used to coax the still-living trees from the ground and shape them for use on the water. Several noble houses of Cothique sponsor mages from their own families who spend their lives dedicated to this task, as it is so vital to maintain their naval strength.

Kurnous and Anath Raema

Kurnous is often worshipped by fishermen, who bless their hooks, nets, and spears in a similar fashion to how archers bless their arrowheads. More ambitious (or foolhardy) hunters are sometimes drawn to pursue Cothique’s sea monsters in the name of Anath Raema. This practice is considered a great offence by the priesthood of Mathlann. They call upon these creatures in times of strife, sometimes know them by name, and insist that to hunt them for selfish reasons would be to risk Mathlann’s violent displeasure.

Vaul and the Gold Wind

The harsh conditions of Cothique punish Asur creations, from humble everyday items to their grandest works. Many objects are enchanted with simple weatherproofing charms, and the Gold Wind Chamon is often employed for mending. The grandest Cothiqui ships are shaped from salt-kissed livewood using rites employing Ghyran and Chamon. These vessels naturally resist the elements and heal damage over time, but their making must be undertaken with extreme care lest the spirits of the trees turn rebellious.

Quality craftsmanship is a must for smaller items as well, as even if fixed or made resilient by magic, garments and practical goods that are poorly made do not last long. Vaul sees widespread worship as a result, from enthusiasts making their own fishing rods and canoes to trade craftsmen fashioning exportable goods. The Cult of Vaul has a major temple in Cothique, the Sky Forge, that stands among the Annulii Mountains, adding to its influence. Purists from the cult sometimes object to local practice, however, as the priests occasionally fashion goods for export themselves.

Hoeth

The Cult of Hoeth has a significant influence in Cothique. Tor Vael has long been a centre of study and learning for the cult, and loremasters give counsel and conduct inquiry throughout the kingdom, much to its benefit. Even the boldest sailors often whisper prayers to Hoeth for guidance — after all, few places require quick, clear thinking more than the dangerous seas of the Shifting Isles. For the less devout, the cult offers to cast mind-quickening charms for a nominal donation.

Of late, swordmasters have become a frequent sight in Tor Andar and Tor Koruali. The reign of phoenix king Finubar has seen profits rise for Cothique’s merchants but has also sparked a resurgence of interest in cults of pleasure and luxury. Some foreign visitors may wonder how any cultist could hide from such inquisitors, but the outgoing and open-minded lifestyle common to Cothique helps mask cult activity, and, unlike Human witch hunters, a swordmaster only acts if they feel their suspicions are clearly justified.

Khaine

Life on the ocean can become unexpectedly violent, and the possibility of sudden, pitched battle hangs heavy over many in Cothique. Attacks on merchant vessels are not uncommon, and the kingdom still bears the scars of invasion. Any Elf may resort to a quick prayer to Khaine when under violent duress, but his repeated invocation can rapidly imbalance the spirit, replacing the fears that drive one to beseech the god of murder with a lust for violence in his name.

Cultists of Khaine carry out his bloodthirsty mission wherever they may. In Cothique, such cultists can be found on the open ocean, concealing anointed daggers that grant their wielders exquisite thrills when wet with lifeblood. These murderers often gravitate towards piratical captains or else become them, craving the adrenaline of seaborne violence.

Atharti and Cults of Pleasure and Luxury

The ocean provides opportunities for wealth, and the Cult of Atharti promises greater riches and pleasures should they be sought in her name. Atharti is a goddess of seduction, and her cultists are experts at convincing others to embrace their hedonistic lifestyles. Cults of pleasure and luxury pay her significant obeisance, and her worship has grown as Cothique has continued to import novel luxuries.

Many of these cults masquerade as clubs of aestheticists, highborn socialites, and merchants, and whilst the behaviour they promote is selfish, they act within the same bounds as any other trader or sophisticate pursuing self-enrichment and appreciation of the finer things in life. The swordmasters monitor these cults, but rarely interfere, as to round up and arrest Atharti’s worshippers would cause a political vacuum that would only be to the ultimate benefit of Ulthuan’s foes.

Instead, resources are allocated to rooting out her most ardent devotees. These pleasure-seekers are sufficiently aligned to Atharti that they must also pay obeisances to her sister, Hekarti, to avoid drawing the jealous sibling’s ire. Hekarti is the goddess of Dark Magic and, whatever the reason for their supplications, rewards those who sacrifice to her with knowledge of sorcerous power. She demands blood and favours spellcasters who spurn her for her sister above all other offerings.

Slaanesh

These cults, however, are not the swordmasters’ highest priorities. Above all else, they stand vigil against a god whose true name, many believe, must never be spoken: Slaanesh, the Lord of Excess. Cothique is fertile ground for the machinations of the Chaos God, as the ambition, opportunity, and wealth of the kingdom are breeding pools for desire. Cultists of Slaanesh can be from any walk of life; the only thing that truly unites them is all-consuming desire.

Known Atharti cults are an evil that pales in comparison to that of the Thirsting Prince — while unwholesome and dangerous, Atharti is, at least, an Elven god. Loremasters sometimes tolerate the activities of less severe pleasure cults to reduce the strength of taboo, one of Slaanesh’s favourite lures. They also provide a gathering place where agents of the god are likely to appear. Many loremasters are willing to wager the Atharti worshippers’ souls against their ability to detect something worse.

The Cult of Slaanesh is widespread and deep-rooted in Cothique’s society. The perverse gifts of the Dark Prince deceive, beguile, and corrupt in terrifyingly subtle ways, and those who embrace Chaos on Ulthuan are particularly adept at concealing themselves among lesser evils. Worshippers of Slaanesh thrive amongst the pleasure cults, but almost always in secret, as only the most arrogant believe themselves capable of consorting with Chaos and escaping unscathed.
q5JIBsVjrup8wult.text:
Обычные чары Котика отражают нужды и желания: от трудолюбивых рыбацких молитв до хищных порывов пиратов. Морские традиции, открытость миру и стойкость к суровой погоде делают местную практику непохожей на другие королевства.

Матланн

Бог океанов — главный в Котике. Другие асуры боятся непостоянства и разрушающего гнева, но здесь чувствуют близость к морю и чтят не только дары, но и испытания, создавшие лучших моряков.

Малые святилища повсюду, почти в каждом доме алтарь, а на мельчайшей лодке руна ради уважения и защиты от обиды. Простые молитвы составляют местную малую магию: молодёжь учат водостойкости вещей и ориентированию в тумане. Ткачи бурь создают сильные чары для самовыравнивающихся астролябий, безупречных компасов, быстровысыхающих одежд, светящихся приманок и прочего.

Их советы в войне, торговле и поведении уважают. Предвидение бурь задаёт ритм страны. Корабли с ткачами опаснейшие: они способны сами топить флоты чудовищами и бурями, а также скрывать суда туманом и направлять ветер ради тактического господства.

Иша и Зелёный Ветер

Поскольку иссечённая ветрами земля трудна для пашни, жители дополняют урожай торговлей, охотой и рыбой. Владение Гираном почти необходимо: оживить засолённую почву или построить и поддержать теплицу —

замкнутую среду, безопаснее открытого океанского ветра. Некоторые растения трудно вырастить даже там; успех считается милостью Иши.

Зелёным Ветром ухаживают за звёздными рощами, важнейшим ресурсом флота. Среди святилищ Иши сложные обряды Гирана и Высокой магии извлекают живые деревья и формуют суда. Знатные дома содержат семейных магов, посвятивших жизнь этой жизненно важной задаче.

Курноус и Анат Раэма

Рыбаки чтут Курноуса, благословляя снасти и копья, как лучники стрелы. Более честолюбивые или глупые охотятся на чудовищ во имя Анат Раэмы. Это оскорбляет жречество Матланна: оно зовёт этих существ в войну, порой знает поимённо и считает корыстную охоту риском божественного гнева.

Ваул и Золотой Ветер

Непогода губит изделия от бытовых до великих. Водостойкость обеспечивают чарами, Шамоном чинят. Великие корабли из солёной живой древесины формуют Гираном и Шамоном; они сопротивляются стихиям и заживают, но изготовление требует осторожности, чтобы духи деревьев не восстали.

Мастерство нужно и малым вещам: даже магически починенное или укреплённое плохое изделие долго не живёт. Ваула чтут любители удочек и каноэ и ремесленники-экспортёры. Влиятельный храм Небесной кузницы стоит в Аннулиях. Но строгие почитатели порой возражают, когда местные жрецы сами делают вещи на продажу.

Хоэт

Культ влиятелен: Тор-Ваэль давно центр учёбы, хранители советуют и исследуют по всей стране. Даже смелые моряки шепчут молитвы ради ясной быстрой мысли в опасных водах. Менее набожным за скромное пожертвование предлагают чары остроты ума.

Мастеров меча всё чаще видят в Тор-Андаре и Тор-Коруали. При Финубаре выросли прибыли и интерес к культам наслаждения. Иностранцы дивятся возможности укрываться от таких дознавателей, но открытый образ жизни маскирует обряды. В отличие от охотников на ведьм, мастер действует лишь при явно обоснованных подозрениях.

Кхейн

Океан внезапно становится жесток: многие ждут возможной битвы, налёты на купцов обычны, шрамы вторжений живы. При опасности любой шепнёт Кхейну, но повторные призывы быстро нарушают баланс, заменяя страх жаждой насилия.

Культисты выполняют кровавое дело повсюду. В открытом море Котика скрывают освящённые кинжалы, дарующие изысканный восторг от крови. Убийцы тянутся к пиратским капитанам или становятся ими ради волнения морской жестокости.

Атхарти и культы наслаждения и роскоши

Море сулит богатство, а культ — ещё большие сокровища и удовольствия во имя богини. Искусные соблазнители привлекают к гедонизму. С ввозом новой роскоши её почитание растёт.

Культы маскируются клубами эстетистов, светской знати и купцов. Эгоистичная тяга к богатству и прекрасному не выходит за пределы обычного торговца или ценителя. Мастера следят, но редко вмешиваются: массовые аресты оставили бы политическую пустоту врагам Ултуана.

Вместо этого ищут наиболее рьяных. Такие поклонники вынуждены умилостивлять ревнивую сестру Гекарти. Богиня Тёмной магии дарует знания за жертвы независимо от причины мольбы. Она требует крови и особенно ценит заклинателей, предпочитающих сестру.

Слаанеш

Но высший приоритет мастеров — бог, чьё настоящее имя, по мнению многих, нельзя произносить: Владыка Излишеств. Честолюбие, возможности и богатство Котика питают желания. Служители из любых слоёв связаны лишь всепоглощающей жаждой.

Зло Атхарти бледнеет перед Жаждущим Князем: при всей опасности она хотя бы эльфийская богиня. Хранители иногда терпят меньшие культы, ослабляя запретность, любимую приманку Слаанеш. Также это место встречи, где появятся его агенты. Многие готовы поставить души поклонников Атхарти против способности заметить худшее.

Культ Слаанеш глубоко укоренён и распространён. Тёмный Князь обманывает и развращает пугающе тонко, а поклонники Хаоса особенно умеют скрываться среди меньшего зла. Они процветают среди культов наслаждения, но почти всегда тайно: только высокомернейшие верят, что переживут связь с Хаосом невредимыми.

P6uv6R9KDTuRimG9.sourceName: The Cults of Pleasure and Luxury
P6uv6R9KDTuRimG9.source:
High Elves are watchful for signs of excess and the forbidden worship of the Cytharai, or gods of the Underworld, or the more insidious cults of pleasure and luxury that indulge in rites to the Chaos God Slaanesh. However, excess can take root in all forms of worship, including that of the Cadai, or gods of the heavens, and corruption festers unless it is purged.

Cult of the Embers of Resistance

Cothique’s violent past brought like-minded Elves together as kindred. In preparation for future invasions, they hide stockpiles of supplies in grottos and abandoned mines. The Embers of Resistance is one of many such groups that prepare in hidden shelters for the prophesied Rhana Dandra, or End Times.

The group attracted the attention of a secret benefactor, whose funds have allowed them to focus on preparations such as combat training, and to set up a retreat on an island in the Shifting Isles. New recruits with combat experience are being sought, and those with military positions are targeted for recruitment so that better weapons can be obtained by the group.

Selected members are taken to the island to compete in bloody tournaments. The victors are inducted into the sacred rites of Khaine and initiated into the cult’s secret belief that Prince Tyrion will take up the Sword of Khaine when Ulthuan’s need is greatest. Cultists move throughout society, removing those they perceive to be weakening Cothique and preparing to assist Tyrion when the time comes.

Shattered Glass

An agent for Prince Arathion is recruiting investigators to explore allegations that his head gardener, Kalebyn Greenfinger, is poisoning his villa. These rumours are the work of the Cult of the Embers of Resistance, seeking to ruin Kalebyn. The cult’s motives are to wait until Kalebyn is desperate for support, recruit him, and transport him to the island where he will prepare its gardens for Tyrion’s ascension. Cultists amongst the villa’s staff are also drawn to items that could be linked to Tyrion, palming small trinkets to be taken to the island’s shrine.

Cult of the Endless Hunt

Whilst many in Tor Koruali have been turning away from fishing with spears in favour of fishing practices involving nets, the merchant house of Caraidh Eldoir-iasg have long worshipped Kurnous, god of the hunt, and continue to fish without nets. Unfortunately, since the enchantment of the Shifting Isles, large schools of fish have become harder to locate as the sporadic movement of shoals and sandbars constantly disrupts the natural order. Resentment has grown towards the net-based practices, and some of the more zealous members of the house of Caraidh Eldoir-iasg have taken to actively sabotaging fishing equipment, or driving schools of fish away from boats crewed by fishermen who make use of nets.

Mirion Swiftspear once rode the waves peacefully on her fish companion until, one day, it became entangled in gillnets from Tor Koruali. In anguish, Mirion cursed the city and set out to destroy all it represents by embracing Anath Raema, goddess of the savage hunt. Seeking retribution, she attacks ships from the mists leading a glide of flying fish.

Many have rallied to her cause, sowing division amongst the merchant houses. Initiation into the cult involves feasting upon sea monster flesh, as it is believed to imbue members with savagery and strength. Squadrons are directed to drive sea monsters towards shipping lanes and the fishing grounds used by trawlers.

The Bitter Taste of Success

Harmony Master Taradhir is unsettled by what he regards as a rising number of Elves in Cothique who seem spiritually imbalanced and prone to aggression. Elves affected have eaten meat from sea monsters, and though parts are believed to have medicinal properties, some cuts have an impact on yenlui. Not wanting a formal investigation, he offers the Characters the opportunity to explore the issue as a form of reflection.

Investigations might lead the Characters to the door of Mage Kyraelle Palemoon, who is attempting to better master the control of sea beasts through the consumption of their meat, supplied by Mirion Swiftspear. This is smuggled into the city and enters the food chain through the @UUID[JournalEntry.rgmnc6cyvSCdaoKT.JournalEntryPage.5yL9Yv9ZHlxihHO4#fish-market]{Fish Market}. Kyraelle is not herself an advocate of Aneth Raema, though she is risking a descent into dark yenlui through her experiments.

Glass Houses

Cothique’s climate presents challenges to farmers, as the winds that scour it kill most crops. These conditions motivated the development of techniques, both magical and mundane, for insulating plants from the elements. The few open farmlands in Cothique that exist are bolstered by a series of windbreaks and barriers, since even robust plants benefit from some modicum of cover during the worst storms.

In contrast to these mundane solutions are the glass houses. They are fine feats of Elven engineering: gleaming structures fashioned almost entirely from glass. They are constructed to create an internal environment with a consistent temperature and humidity, trapping the heat of the sun and keeping out the cold and rain.

Despite the fragile materials used to build them, glass houses must be robust. To strengthen their construction, they are shaped into domes. Enchantments of Aqshy and Hysh can create whatever levels of heat and light are desired, and magic of Chamon can make a glass house’s frame impervious to storm damage. The more the climate inside a glass house differs from the climate outside it, the more powerfully it must be enchanted, and the larger glass houses are home to a resident mage who monitors the spells maintaining it by the hour.

As such, although it is possible to grow nearly anything in a glass house, certain plants are only practical to cultivate in smaller, room-sized enclosures. Generally, these are specimens from the jungles of Lustria or the Southlands, although some less conventional glass houses emulate frigid climates through the employment of enchantments that chill the air and freeze water. The exotic fruits, vegetables, and herbs produced in glass houses lend Cothique’s cuisine some of its unique charm.

Floral Manbane

Among the most wicked poisons in Naggaroth’s arsenal is manbane, a terrifyingly potent anticoagulant that causes tiny wounds to gush like torn arteries. Manbane is made from a particularly rare and beautiful flower, the lathranoi, that is native to the chilly isles north of Nagarythe. A small club of horticulturalists has begun cultivating the flower in secret using magically chilled glass houses. Whilst their work is being carried out in secret, they believe their client to be a pirate from Sartosa, failing to understand the inroads Dark Elves have made in forming contacts there.

Cothiqui Beef

Although the great cattle of Ulthuan are hardy creatures, their robust flesh is ill-suited for consumption. Novel farming techniques have emerged in response to this issue, and farmers in Cothique take care to ensure their livestock is protected from the stresses of predation and parasitism, sheltered from the worst of the weather, and fed a diet of lush grass and aromatic herbs.

Raising livestock in this way is expensive and logistically complex but produces cattle of unparalleled quality. Cothiqui cattle are famed for their mottled fur, white-marbled fat, and the sea-salty essence that permeates their flesh from years of breathing the ocean air. The appearance of the beef is particularly striking, its intense marbling resembles thick seafoam at sunset.

The midsections of these cattle are delicacies of the highest order. The waiting list for such cuts is years long, and obtaining one on short notice requires the right connections and a fat purse. As a result, although the practice has inspired many farmers across Ulthuan to reduce herd sizes and increase standards of care, few outside Cothique attempt to create meat akin to this beef. It is seen as an eccentricity of the kingdom and an indulgent pleasure for many highborn Elves.

Like Cattle to Slaughter

The Characters are offered rich payment to defend a ranch to the west of Tor Koruali for several days until the permanently hired staff arrives in Cothique. They are warned that a pride of White Lions has developed a taste for the cattle and will even break into paddocks and barns to attack them. In truth, the job is a Khainite ruse, meant to create a plausible scenario for a series of violent deaths.
P6uv6R9KDTuRimG9.text:
Высшие эльфы следят за излишествами, запретными ситарай и коварными культами Слаанеш. Но избыток возможен даже в поклонении небесным кадай, а невычищенная порча гниёт.

Культ Углей Сопротивления

Жестокое прошлое объединило единомышленников, готовящих запасы в гротах и заброшенных шахтах для будущих вторжений. Угли — одна из групп, ожидающих Рана Дандру в тайных убежищах.

Тайный благодетель оплатил подготовку, боевую учёбу и островное убежище. Нужны опытные бойцы, особенно занимающие военные должности ради лучшего оружия.

Избранные участвуют в кровавых турнирах. Победителей посвящают Кхейну и вере, что Тирион возьмёт меч в час величайшей нужды. Культисты уничтожают считаемых ослабляющими Котик и готовят помощь Тириону.

Разбитое стекло

Агент принца Аратиона ищет следователей по обвинению садовника Калебина Зелёные Пальцы в отравлении виллы. Слухи распространяет культ, чтобы разорить его, затем отчаявшегося завербовать на остров для садов восхождения Тириона. Слуги-культисты крадут небольшие вещи, связанные с принцем, для святилища.

Культ Бесконечной Охоты

Карайд Элдойр-Иасг издавна чтит Курноуса и ловит без сетей, пока город меняет копья на сети. Чары островов перемещают мели, нарушая природный порядок и затрудняя поиск косяков. Обида растёт: ревностные члены портят сети и отгоняют рыбу от сетевых лодок.

Мирион Быстрое Копьё мирно ездила на рыбе, пока та не запуталась в городских жаберных сетях. В горе она прокляла город и приняла Анат Раэму. Теперь из тумана нападает на суда во главе стаи летучих рыб.

Многие примкнули, разделяя купеческие дома. При посвящении едят чудовищ ради свирепости и силы. Отряды гонят морских монстров к маршрутам и промысловым участкам траулеров.

Горький вкус успеха

Мастер гармонии Тарадхир тревожится ростом духовно неуравновешенных и агрессивных. Они ели чудовищ: некоторые части считаются лечебными, но влияют на йенлуй. Не желая официального дела, он предлагает героям исследование как размышление.

След ведёт к магу Кираэль Бледная Луна, пытающейся управлять зверями через их мясо от Мирион. Контрабанда попадает в пищу через @UUID[JournalEntry.rgmnc6cyvSCdaoKT.JournalEntryPage.5yL9Yv9ZHlxihHO4#fish-market]{Рыбный рынок}. Кираэль не почитает Анат Раэму, но опытами рискует Тёмным йенлуй.

Теплицы

Ветры губят посевы, заставляя развивать магическую и обычную защиту. Немногие поля прикрыты барьерами и ветрозащитой: даже крепким растениям нужна крыша в худшую бурю.

Иной подход — сияющие почти полностью стеклянные сооружения, чудо инженерии, сохраняющие постоянную температуру и влажность, солнечное тепло и защиту от холода и дождя.

Хрупкий материал укрепляют куполом. Акши и Хиш дают желаемые жар и свет, Шамон — неуязвимость каркаса к буре. Чем сильнее внутренний климат отличается от внешнего, тем больше чар. В больших теплицах постоянный маг ежечасно следит за ними.

Можно вырастить почти всё, но часть видов практична лишь в небольших комнатных помещениях, обычно джунглей Люстрии и Южноземья. Необычные теплицы воспроизводят мороз, охлаждая воздух и замораживая воду. Экзотические плоды, овощи и травы придают местной кухне особое очарование.

Цветочный человекогуб

Среди худших наггаротских ядов человекогуб — антикоагулянт, превращающий малую рану в поток крови как из артерии. Его получают из редкого прекрасного латраной северных холодных островов. Клуб садоводов тайно выращивает цветок в магически охлаждаемых теплицах, считая заказчика сартозским пиратом и не понимая друкайских связей там.

Говядина Котика

Крепкий скот Ултуана даёт жёсткую неподходящую плоть. Новые приёмы защищают от хищников, паразитов и непогоды, кормят сочной травой и ароматными травами.

Дорогое и сложное выращивание даёт непревзойдённый скот с пятнистой шерстью, беломраморным жиром и морской солёностью от лет океанского воздуха. Мраморность мяса похожа на густую пену заката.

Средние отрубы — высший деликатес с многолетним ожиданием. Срочный заказ требует связей и кошелька. По всему острову уменьшают стада и улучшают уход, но подобного мяса почти не производят вне Котика, считая местной причудой и роскошью знати.

Как скот на убой

Богато платят за несколько дней защиты ранчо западнее столицы до прибытия постоянных работников. Предупреждают о белых львах, полюбивших скот и ломающих загоны и амбары. На деле это уловка Кхейна ради правдоподобного ряда насильственных смертей.

kDW5cYrYzEsqtw5S.source:
Created during the reign of Phoenix King Bel-Hathor to guard against Norse raiding, the eastern sea routes to Ulthuan are protected by potent and complex spells designed to confuse and confound, and the islands that make up the archipelago in the area have no fixed positions, making charting the region a matter of vague approximation at best. Three decades of preparation culminated in powerful enchantments that wreathed the area in illusions and mists making it all but impossible to reach Ulthuan except by chance. The magical rotation of shoals and sandbars means a multitude of aquatic plants and sealife are washed ashore, allowing the Elves of Cothique to collect the prized pearl-leafed torrelain and delightfully scented moon rose.

Those entering the enchantment without guidance risk becoming lost as compasses spin and the stars are obscured. Crews of lost vessels face starvation or shipwreck unless spotted by flying fish riders, fishermen from the merchant houses of Caraidh Eldoir-iasg, that inhabit the isles. If found, such crews are restocked and escorted towards Cothique or back to the open ocean. Even High Elf sailors can become confused in the area, though many are still recruited as pilots by Human merchants in @UUID[.cZ41kn5ffw5LA2H1]{Rokhame}, situated on the edge of the region. Within the enchantment, smugglers and cultists run the risk of being marooned, wrecked, or forever lost, but if they survive, they can evade the eyes of the authorities there.

Since the ruin of Yvresse and the destruction of many waystones, the degradation of leylines has corrupted the enchantment, making the area even more dangerous. Now, within the enchanted archipelago, daemons lurk alongside sea monsters. Patrols of hawkships guard the western sea-routes closest to Cothique, ensuring safe passage, while the shipwrecks of the unfortunate are searched by merchant adventurers for treasures.

The Shifting Isles cannot be charted in the normal way. To successfully traverse the area involves reading the Winds of Magic that flow amongst the complex pattern of spells, leylines, and waystones. Elven magical charts, with ever-changing coloured lines and markers upon paper, are highly guarded, and can only be understood by those who can read Elthárin and pass a Combined Difficult (–10) Lore (Magic) and Navigation Test. Elves also use wayshards attuned to an individual waystone in Ulthuan that allow the bearer to sense the position of individual waystones, and thus navigate the world.

Navigating the Shifting Isles

To navigate the Shifting Isles, a Navigation Test is required once per day (see the Through the Mists table).

The following modifiers apply to the Test:

  • Without Second Sight Talent: –2 SL

  • Able to read and use magical sea chart: +2 SL

  • Navigator possesses a Wayshard: +1 SL

For detailed rules on seafaring, see @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-soc.journals.JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.dhBZq8o8K27gQH9X]{Seafaring} .

Through the Mists

SL

Effect

+4 or more

A mysterious wind blows. You arrive at your destination early: weeks of travel turn to days, days to hours.

+0 to +3

Success! You successfully navigate the mists and illusions, avoiding the shifting sandbars and shoals.

–0 to –1

You enter magically still water or run aground on a sandbar. You must wait [[/r 2d10]] hours until the enchantment renews before continuing (retest Navigation).

–2 to –4

The enchanted mists surround your vessel, confusing the direction of travel, you emerge from the Shifting Isles but are off course by [[/r 1d100+100]]{100 + 1d100} miles.

–5 or less

Strange lights appear in the mists, and upon exiting, you discover the vessel is turned around to exit the Shifting Isles from the direction you entered.
kDW5cYrYzEsqtw5S.text:
При Бел-Хаторе ради защиты от норсов восточные пути окутали сложными чарами. Острова не имеют постоянных мест, а карта лишь приблизительна. Три десятилетия подготовки завершились иллюзиями и туманами, делающими доступ случайностью. Движение мелей выбрасывает морскую жизнь и растения, позволяя собирать жемчужнолистный торрелайн и душистую лунную розу.

Без проводника компасы вращаются, звёзды скрыты, грозит голод и кораблекрушение. Рыбаки Карайд Элдойр-Иасг верхом на летучих рыбах ищут потерявшихся, снабжают и проводят к Котику или в океан. Даже эльфы путаются, хотя люди нанимают их лоцманами в @UUID[.cZ41kn5ffw5LA2H1]{Рокхейме} у края чар. Контрабандисты и культисты рискуют застрять и погибнуть, но выжившие избегают властей.

После разорения Иврессе и гибели камней ухудшение линий испортило чары. Теперь рядом с чудовищами демоны. Корабли-ястребы охраняют ближайшие западные пути, а путешественники ищут сокровища затонувших.

Обычная карта бесполезна: нужно читать Ветры в узоре чар, линий и камней. Магические карты с меняющимися цветными линиями и метками тщательно охраняются. Их понимает читающий эльтарин после совмещённой трудной (–10) проверки Знания (магия) и Ориентирования. Настроенные на отдельный камень путевые осколки тоже дают его направление для навигации.

Навигация Блуждающих островов

Для движения нужна одна проверка Ориентирования в день; см. таблицу «Сквозь туманы».

Модификаторы:

  • Без Второго зрения: –2 УУ

  • Может читать и использовать магическую карту: +2 УУ

  • Есть путевой осколок: +1 УУ

Подробные правила: @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-soc.journals.JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.dhBZq8o8K27gQH9X]{Мореплавание}.

Сквозь туманы

УУ

Эффект

+4 или больше

Загадочный ветер ускоряет путь: недели становятся днями, дни — часами.

От +0 до +3

Успех: туманы, иллюзии и изменчивые мели преодолены.

От –0 до –1

Волшебный штиль или посадка на мель. Ждите [[/r 2d10]] часов обновления чар и повторите Ориентирование.

От –2 до –4

Туманы сбивают направление. Вы выходите из островов в [[/r 1d100+100]]{100 + 1d100} милях от курса.

–5 или меньше

Три десятилетия подготовки завершились иллюзиями и туманами, делающими доступ случайностью. Движение мелей выбрасывает морскую жизнь и растения, позволяя собирать жемчужнолистный торрелайн и душистую лунную розу.

Cothique is known for its rugged landscape and difficult seas. It is a land of harsh weather and bears old but ugly scars of having been besieged multiple times during bitter conflicts with the Dark Elves of Naggaroth. It may be a surprise to those who travel to Ulthuan to learn that many sites in the kingdom of Cothique are built, partially or wholly, underground. Exposure to enemies and the elements alike has forced Cothique’s Elves to dig into the shale and soil of their homeland, and grand redoubts and defensible tunnels have been carved beneath the cliffside settlements that overlook its shores.

Craggy Coastal Plains

Great ridges and rock formations stand proud throughout the barren plains of the mainland, and the coasts are craggy and exposed to storms. The rocky terrain, stony soil, and windy weather render much of the kingdom unfit for productive farming without magical assistance. Although some arable lands have been cleared by a dedicated few, much of Cothique’s produce is imported, and its people tend to enjoy diets richer in seafood than is normal on Ulthuan.

Since ancient times, the majority of Cothique’s settlements have been coastal. Its cities are built high on cliffsides and dug down into the rock, built to weather storms and invaders alike. Magically reinforced glass stretches over the top of dug-in areas, allowing natural light and a view of the often-stormy skies above. On sunnier days, the walls of buildings in its whitestone cities are decorated with murals evoking the seas, heavens, and gods. Such artwork is intentionally ephemeral beauty, as Cothique’s harsh conditions soon wash the scenes away.

The kingdom borders the wild and forested realm of Chrace to the north, and the misty and mournful land of Yvresse to the south. Although its rocky plains resemble those of Yvresse, Cothique is windswept and dry, whereas the notorious fogs of its southern neighbour bring moisture and mud. The shrine of Vaul found to the north-west of Cothique is of particular importance to its neighbours, as the priests there possess the skill to shape and repair ithilmar. Even farther north is the Blighted Isle, Altar of Khaine, and the legendary Widowmaker, whose baleful influence, some say, stretches all the way across the sea to reach Cothique itself.

The Forest of Cothique

To the west of Cothique is Avelorn, although it is only accessible through the perilous Chasm of Sorrows. This pass, difficult as it is, is one of few access points to the inner ring of Ulthuan. Some military theorists argue this explains why Cothique has seen the brunt of so many attacks on the island, although no proper army could make use of the route. Like Avelorn and neighbouring Chrace, Cothique is a forested realm. Beyond the band of craggy land of the coastal regions, a vast forest rises up, full of dense stands of pine and birch that thrive despite the poor soil and cold wind. This woodland blankets the inland and the foothills of the Annulii Mountains to the kingdom’s southern edge.

The eastern reaches of the Great Ocean lie east of Cothique. The enchantment of the Shifting Isles, woven to protect Ulthuan from naval aggression, makes the oceans particularly difficult to navigate and the smaller islands a true challenge to reliably locate. Small shrines to Mathlann are scattered throughout the isles, many of which are tended only by itinerant storm weavers and sailors who, by the mercy of the god, chance upon them for safe harbour in a storm.

The Shifting Isles

Created during the reign of Phoenix King Bel-Hathor to guard against Norse raiding, the eastern sea routes to Ulthuan are protected by potent and complex spells designed to confuse and confound, and the islands that make up the archipelago in the area have no fixed positions, making charting the region a matter of vague approximation at best. Three decades of preparation culminated in powerful enchantments that wreathed the area in illusions and mists making it all but impossible to reach Ulthuan except by chance. The magical rotation of shoals and sandbars means a multitude of aquatic plants and sealife are washed ashore, allowing the Elves of Cothique to collect the prized pearl-leafed torrelain and delightfully scented moon rose.

Those entering the enchantment without guidance risk becoming lost as compasses spin and the stars are obscured. Crews of lost vessels face starvation or shipwreck unless spotted by flying fish riders, fishermen from the merchant houses of Caraidh Eldoir-iasg, that inhabit the isles. If found, such crews are restocked and escorted towards Cothique or back to the open ocean. Even High Elf sailors can become confused in the area, though many are still recruited as pilots by Human merchants in Rokhame, situated on the edge of the region. Within the enchantment, smugglers and cultists run the risk of being marooned, wrecked, or forever lost, but if they survive, they can evade the eyes of the authorities there.

Since the ruin of Yvresse and the destruction of many waystones, the degradation of leylines has corrupted the enchantment, making the area even more dangerous. Now, within the enchanted archipelago, daemons lurk alongside sea monsters. Patrols of hawkships guard the western sea-routes closest to Cothique, ensuring safe passage, while the shipwrecks of the unfortunate are searched by merchant adventurers for treasures.

The Shifting Isles cannot be charted in the normal way. To successfully traverse the area involves reading the Winds of Magic that flow amongst the complex pattern of spells, leylines, and waystones. Elven magical charts, with ever-changing coloured lines and markers upon paper, are highly guarded, and can only be understood by those who can read Elthárin and pass a Combined Difficult (–10) Lore (Magic) and Navigation Test. Elves also use wayshards attuned to an individual waystone in Ulthuan that allow the bearer to sense the position of individual waystones, and thus navigate the world.

Navigating the Shifting Isles

To navigate the Shifting Isles, a Navigation Test is required once per day (see the Through the Mists table).

The following modifiers apply to the Test:

  • Without Second Sight Talent: –2 SL

  • Able to read and use magical sea chart: +2 SL

  • Navigator possesses a Wayshard: +1 SL

For detailed rules on seafaring, see @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-soc.journals.JournalEntry.IyprYPBVX3cxxO2w.JournalEntryPage.dhBZq8o8K27gQH9X]{Seafaring} .

Through the Mists

SL

Effect

+4 or more

A mysterious wind blows. You arrive at your destination early: weeks of travel turn to days, days to hours.

+0 to +3

Success! You successfully navigate the mists and illusions, avoiding the shifting sandbars and shoals.

–0 to –1

You enter magically still water or run aground on a sandbar. You must wait [[/r 2d10]] hours until the enchantment renews before continuing (retest Navigation).

–2 to –4

The enchanted mists surround your vessel, confusing the direction of travel, you emerge from the Shifting Isles but are off course by [[/r 1d100+100]]{100 + 1d100} miles.

–5 or less

Strange lights appear in the mists, and upon exiting, you discover the vessel is turned around to exit the Shifting Isles from the direction you entered.

The Dead Shale Sea

South of Tor Koruali is an expanse of waters where hunters seek glory and sea burials are performed to sate the megalodons that roam its depths. During festivals linked with the moon Sariour (Mannslieb), the Elves of Cothique celebrate through the Sea Dragon Dance, in which dancers cavort alongside sinuous and massive animated illusions of merwyrms.

Elven legends speak of Mathlann’s trident rending open the seafloor, releasing his children, in the raising of Ulthuan from the seas. Another hypothesis suggests they come from beneath Ulthuan, where an entire species of aquatic people lurk. Loremasters, in the quest for knowledge, sometimes venture too deeply into the Dead Shale Sea seeking answers to questions best left alone.

The Dead Shale Sea

South of Tor Koruali is an expanse of waters where hunters seek glory and sea burials are performed to sate the megalodons that roam its depths. During festivals linked with the moon Sariour (Mannslieb), the Elves of Cothique celebrate through the Sea Dragon Dance, in which dancers cavort alongside sinuous and massive animated illusions of merwyrms.

Elven legends speak of Mathlann’s trident rending open the seafloor, releasing his children, in the raising of Ulthuan from the seas. Another hypothesis suggests they come from beneath Ulthuan, where an entire species of aquatic people lurk. Loremasters, in the quest for knowledge, sometimes venture too deeply into the Dead Shale Sea seeking answers to questions best left alone.

Whitereach Bay

Whitereach Bay is known for massive waves, riptide currents, and whitestone spires that extend from the sea like grasping fingers. The rocky crevices beneath the bay are littered with shipwrecks and skulking monsters. Cadets from Seasong Academy in Tor Koruali attempt to prove they have the favour of Mathlann by cliff diving to retrieve a pearl-bearing oyster from the depths. Golden tokens set with these pearls are said to ensure a marriage weathers any storm. When the tide is low, the shallows split into ephemeral lagoons, though the returning waters rise so quickly that unwary beachcombers may be trapped.

Starwood Groves

The Starwood Groves are simultaneously among Cothique’s greatest military resources and most beautiful places. The tall stands of trees virtually thrum with magical power. Light filtered through the cloud-scraping canopy carries the White Wind Hysh, and the animals possess an uncanny intellect. A special kind of Spite called Luminescents are plentiful. The magical essence of these Spites is similar to starwood itself, but cannot be extracted without destroying them.

The Burned Glades

The Burned Glades are a stretch of scorched stumps and brushland that runs from geothermal vents beneath Tor Dynal to basalt cliffs beneath the Sky Forge. This strip of scorched earth follows a leyline and is the aftereffect of a magical disaster that occurred during the Sundering, and is riddled with seawater geysers, glowing coals, and dangerous heat. Although a delegation of mages has made significant progress in syphoning excess Aqshy back into the leyline, the ground remains scalding hot. A small shrine to Addaioth is located at the centre of the area.

Chasm of Sorrows

The Chasm of Sorrows is a narrow and perilous route that connects Cothique to the mouth of Avelorn’s River Vilu via the Annuliis. The pathway that follows the ravine is barely a person wide for much of its length, and the ravine plunges all the way down to sea level, and monsters are known to lurk there. As such, despite providing access to Ulthuan’s Inner Kingdoms, only the brave, foolish, or desperate would travel through it. On occasion, small groups of Elves vanish into the chasm, and those who return do not tell of what happened to their companions.

Isle of Endless Chill

A perpetually snowy island surrounded by ice floes. A lighthouse, staffed year-round, guards a magical focus that helps regulate the enchantment of the Shifting Isles. The Shrine of the Widowmaker can be seen from the isle, and it is frequented by austere visitors rumoured to belong to the Cult of the Forbidden Blade, a group of assassins committed to killing anyone they believe is likely to draw the Widowmaker.

Rokhame

Rokhame is a forested island in the fertile but tempestuous zone at the edge of the enchantment of the Shifting Isles. A rural community flourishes here on the blessings of Mathlann and rebuilds after weathering his wrath. Morelion, firstborn of Aenarion, lived here for some time, and some of his descendants still reside on the islands. They are invariably skilled warriors, essential in fending off frequent raids. Warriors from Rokhame are often found in Tor Koruali competing in tournaments at the Gymnasium or duelling at the Galineth Amphitheater.

Sky Forge

The Sky Forge is a fortified tower that also serves as a shrine to Vaul. It is seated atop a mountainside ridge, built along a basalt spur at the end of the Burned Glades. As the Forge of Vaul is located on the exact opposite end of Ulthuan, the Sky Forge serves as a crucial centre of ithilmar craft and repair for the northeastern kingdoms. Smith-priests at the Sky Forge fashion many weapons for Cothique’s navy and valuable trade goods besides, including the occasional ithilmar piece. The practice of producing goods for trade is a source of controversy within the cult and without. Smith-priests from the Cadai temple in Tor Koruali deliver magical items and rare minerals to and from the Sky Forge.

The Seven Sisters

Standing at the border with the kingdom of Yvresse are seven colossal statues of Elven maidens, arranged to overlook the cliffs of Tor Koruali‘s bay. This mysterious shrine is often associated with the Cytharai goddess Ladrielle. The Elves of Cothique do not worship her as exuberantly as those from Yvresse, but they do not approach her with the reticence that Elves of the Inner Kingdoms do. Sea Elf mariners visit the Sisters to pray for good fortune before embarking on long journeys. The monument is positioned at a powerful magical junction, where a leyline that traces its origins to distant Couronne intersects and feeds magic into the outermost ring of waystones that encircle Ulthuan.

Tor Dynal

Tor Dynal sits high on a peninsula bluff and serves as a centre of astronomical and astrological study due to its high towers and clear summer skies. The city frequently produces seers who are in demand as navigators and consultants, often leading to tensions with the cult of Mathlann. While storm weavers frequently visit Tor Dynal to share theories and observations on behalf of the Celestial Observatory in Tor Koruali, they do not enjoy their time in the city, as there is a pervading air of sorrow. Tor Dynal is littered with subtle shrines to Morai-Heg, and around the new moon, corvids tend to outnumber seagulls in its surroundings. The city has come under recent scrutiny after the discovery of an assassination plot led to several highborn sons being executed by the swordmasters, the latest in a series of tragic events that shape life in this mournful place.

Elisia

Elisia is the sister city of Tor Dynal, though it lies to the south and, historically, has benefited from the protection of the other city. Invaders from the sea must get past Tor Dynal to strike at Elisia, and this has led to a degree of resentment between the citizens of the two cities. The Elves of Tor Dynal claim those of Elisia do little to pull their weight in wartime, whilst the folk of Elisia mutter that on occasions Dark Elves have struck past their defences, it must have been due to the complacency, or perhaps even the complicity, of their neighbours. The city climbs from the sea along cliffs from which several waterfalls pour down into serene reflecting pools. Criss-crossed stairways and sky bridges connect many of Elisia’s towering white stone spires, many of which are among the oldest structures in Cothique. The ruling princess, Litharys Starshard, commands Cothique’s capital fleet, which means she can often be found at the Tor Koruali Naval Base.

Mistnar

Mistnar is the name of a small but bustling town built around a cove on an island in the Shifting Isles that was founded during the early years of the reign of Finubar the Seafarer. It has become a haven for craftsmen and itinerant merchants. Its stony cliffs form an effective, natural defence, and Mistnar is famously successful at repelling invaders from the north. The island is legally part of the domain of Tor Andar, but in reality, it is dominated by the Merchant House Tallaindeloth as part of a Marienburg-inspired taxation scheme. The Waverider house owns a new palace in Tor Koruali, from where it lobbies for Mistnar to receive a council seat.

Tor Andar

Tor Andar is a rugged fortress city that was once outgrown by the demands of its itinerant fleets. Although Cothiqueâ€™s navy is returning to its former glory, recent policies have ensured that at any given time, most of Tor Andarâ€™s ships are away from port. At one time, additional docking was constructed outside the cityâ€™s walls, but many of these structures only see use during rare periods of ill-planned overcrowding, or else for stashing loot gained from piratical actions. Tor Andar is the first line of defence against serious naval threats, and the only part of Cothique many sailors frequently see. Given its strategic importance, it is generally closed to outsiders. The mighty kraken that inhabit Tor Andarâ€™s waters are periodically culled with approval from the temple of Mathlann in Tor Koruali, a risky task that only the most experienced monster hunters are capable of carrying out with any degree of success.

Tor Vael

Tor Vael is an inland city that sits near the entrance of the Chasm of Sorrows, guarding one of of the few mountain passes between Cothiqueâ€™s and the Inner Kingdoms. The chasm is as dangerous as its name suggests, and fine warriors with no interest in the ocean make their living in Tor Vael by offering to guide travellers safely along the edge of the chasm. The city features a temple of Hoeth, and serves as the base for Cothiqueâ€™s loremasters, who are often the first to receive visitors from Avelorn. The city has long been known for its importance to the loremasters and is home to a remote underground chamber known as the Vault, where a number of magical artefacts are kept under their dutiful watch.

Tor Alin

The boyhood home of Tyrion and Teclis is a town at the base of the peninsula upon which Tor Koruali stands. Several villages and hunting retreats can be found in the woods nearby, as the forest in the area is among the most verdant in the kingdom. Forest spirits congregate here and delight in causing mischief for travellers unfamiliar with their ways. Cothique’s largest temple to Asuryan is here, and assigns acolytes to maintain a lighthouse shrine on the outskirts of Tor Koruali.

Ruins of Anirain

This sad site of shattered marble towers and scattered paving stones is all that remains of Cothique’s former capital, destroyed millennia ago during the Sundering. Efforts to reclaim or rebuild the city have been famously unlucky, ruined by everything from devastating storms to the invasions of Norse raiders and the Goblins of Grom the Paunch. Surface-level rubble has long been overgrown by seagrass, but the dead city’s broken face continues to erode, exposing an ever more porous crag of lost halls and dark caverns. Dark shadows lurk in the passages beneath sea level, where cave-ins are common.

Tor Koruali

The largest and most politically important city in Cothique is Tor Koruali, which stands on a narrow peninsula of land close to the border with Yvresse. Whilst High Elves do not really regard any particular prince or city as the kingdom’s ultimate decision maker, as some Human societies do, Tor Koruali may be thought of as the region’s capital for all intents and purposes and is covered in detail in chapter 2.

Котик известен суровым ландшафтом и трудными морями. Непогода и старые уродливые шрамы осад друкаев удивляют гостей тем, что многие места частично или полностью под землёй. Враги и стихии заставили врезаться в почву и сланец, создав большие редуты и защитные туннели под прибрежными поселениями.

Скалистые прибрежные равнины

Над пустыми равнинами поднимаются хребты и скалы, берега открыты бурям. Каменная почва и ветры мешают земледелию без магии. Немногие расчистили пашни, но много пищи ввозят, а морепродуктов едят больше обычного.

С древности селились у моря, высоко на утёсах и внутри скал, защищаясь от бурь и врагов. Магически укреплённое стекло покрывает заглублённые участки, давая свет и вид неба. В солнце стены белокаменных городов украшают морем, небесами и богами. Красота намеренно эфемерна: непогода скоро смывает росписи.

Северная граница — дикий лесной Крейс, южная — туманный скорбный Иврессе. Равнины схожи, но Котик сух и ветрен, сосед влажен и грязен. Святилище Ваула на северо-западе важно соседям: там формуют и чинят итильмар. Ещё севернее Гиблый остров, алтарь и Вдоводел, чья тьма, говорят, достигает Котика через море.

Лес Котика

К западу от Котика лежит Авелорн, но добраться туда можно лишь через опасное Ущелье Скорбей. Несмотря на трудность пути, это один из немногих проходов во внутреннее кольцо Ултуана. Некоторые военные теоретики считают, что именно поэтому на Котик обрушилось столько нападений на остров, хотя полноценная армия этим путём пройти не сможет. Как Авелорн и соседний Крейс, Котик — лесное королевство. За полосой прибрежной скалистой земли начинается огромный лес с густыми соснами и берёзами, процветающими вопреки бедным почвам и холодным ветрам. Он покрывает внутренние земли и предгорья Аннулий до южной границы королевства.

К востоку от Котика простираются восточные воды Великого океана. Чары Блуждающих островов, призванные защищать Ултуан от нападений с моря, крайне затрудняют навигацию и делают поиск небольших островов настоящим испытанием. По островам рассеяны малые святилища Матланна. За многими ухаживают лишь странствующие ткачи бурь и моряки, которые по милости бога случайно находят здесь безопасное укрытие от бури.

Блуждающие острова

При Бел-Хаторе ради защиты от норсов восточные пути окутали сложными чарами. Острова не имеют постоянных мест, а карта лишь приблизительна. Три десятилетия подготовки завершились иллюзиями и туманами, делающими доступ случайностью. Движение мелей выбрасывает морскую жизнь и растения, позволяя собирать жемчужнолистный торрелайн и душистую лунную розу.

Без проводника компасы вращаются, звёзды скрыты, грозит голод и кораблекрушение. Рыбаки Карайд Элдойр-Иасг верхом на летучих рыбах ищут потерявшихся, снабжают и проводят к Котику или в океан. Даже эльфы путаются, хотя люди нанимают их лоцманами в Рокхейме у края чар. Контрабандисты и культисты рискуют застрять и погибнуть, но выжившие избегают властей.

После разорения Иврессе и гибели камней ухудшение линий испортило чары. Теперь рядом с чудовищами демоны. Корабли-ястребы охраняют ближайшие западные пути, а путешественники ищут сокровища затонувших.

Обычная карта здесь бесполезна: нужно читать Ветры в сложном узоре чар, линий и камней. Магические карты с непрерывно меняющимися цветными линиями и знаками тщательно охраняются. Их понимает читающий эльтарин после совмещённой трудной (–10) проверки Знания (магия) и Ориентирования. Настроенные на отдельные камни путевые осколки тоже позволяют чувствовать их положение и находить путь.

Навигация Блуждающих островов

Для движения нужна одна проверка Ориентирования в день; см. таблицу «Сквозь туманы».

Модификаторы:

  • Без Второго зрения: –2 УУ

Мёртвое Сланцевое Море

К югу от Тор-Коруали простираются воды, где охотники ищут славы, а погребения в море призваны насытить мегалодонов, обитающих в глубинах. Во время праздников, связанных с луной Сариур (Маннслиб), эльфы Котика исполняют Танец Морского Дракона: танцоры движутся рядом с громадными извивающимися оживлёнными иллюзиями морских змеев.

Эльфийские легенды гласят, что, когда Ултуан поднимался из моря, трезубец Матланна разверз морское дно и выпустил его детей. По другой гипотезе, они приходят из-под Ултуана, где скрывается целый народ водных существ.
